next_gw_decisions.model_note: Heuristic decision support using FPL form/PPG, fixture difficulty, availability, mini-league ownership and ownership among the nearest three managers above you. It is not projected points.

current_next_gw_decisions.model_note: Transfers are ranked by post-transfer legal Best XI impact first, with smaller structural/ownership value. Bench-only upgrades pay a free-transfer opportunity-cost penalty.

current_action.headline: Hold / roll
current_action.reason: The leading transfer edge is 14.8 projected points over holding and does not yet clear the full evidence hurdle with sufficient agreement on that exact route.

forward_plan.note: Forward paths are planning evidence, not instructions to pre-commit future transfers. Re-optimise after each deadline and new information.

chips.reason: Hold chips. Best visible TC uplift is 0.0 and BB uplift is 12.6, but the first-half portfolio remains comfortable with 13 slack Gameweeks. Preserve option value for stronger blank/double or squad-structure windows.

decision_synthesis.method_note: Authoritative decision gate. It synthesises single-step Monte Carlo, multi-GW beam search, probabilistic rival response, live transfer-hit state, season maturity and chip option value. A high-scoring route is promoted only when that same measured route clears both magnitude and cross-model support thresholds.
